crossRefs.note: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be…
How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
“Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power…
You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand…
“Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.
Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his…

translations.web: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
translations.bsb: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
